r4subrepro: Reproducibility and Reviewability Indicators for Clinical Submissions

Source: R/r4subrepro-package.R
r4subrepro-package.Rd

Scores the computational reproducibility and reviewer readiness of an R based regulatory submission by statically inspecting its analysis code folder. Checks for a captured package environment, path hygiene, a single entry point, hidden setup assumptions, undeclared proprietary packages, clean run evidence, and script complexity, following the reproducibility guidance for making R submissions reviewable for regulators. Emits standardised R4SUB (Ready for Submission) evidence table rows via 'r4subcore' for integration with 'r4subscore' and 'r4subprofile'.
